clue.text: Men-of-war charged with men-of-war

explanation.definitionFit: These vessels transport soldiers for military campaigns, so they belong to a fleet's fighting ships and are also loaded with fighting men.

clue.text: One's taken hostage over in east Elba, Tuscany
